Tailslide's test scripts (data only)

What:   scripts/   the LSL scripts Tailslide tests itself with: real scripts and
                   pathological ones, 122 files. Its `expected/` folder (the
                   CIL, LSO and pretty-printed output its own back ends are
                   compared with) is left out.

From:   https://github.com/secondlife/tailslide, tests/scripts
        Commit f950e066863f215c2d22c66fc9498b12d4387b7f
        MIT (LICENSE). Tailslide's NOTICE.txt says of these files: "LSL scripts
        are from various sources and the property of their respective owners."

Why:    Tailslide is the LSL parser and checker Linden Lab publishes, and this
        corpus is what it holds itself to. A script marks the errors Tailslide
        must report with `$[E1xxxx]` in a comment on the line (E2xxxx are
        warnings), so the corpus says for each script whether a compiler should
        accept it. falcon/tests/compat runs Falcon over it and tracks how many
        of the accepted scripts compile.

        Tailslide itself is not built or linked here: Falcon's parser is
        handwritten (ADR 0021). Only its test data is used.

Vendored 2026-11-19 from Ashley's Rookery scripting package, which carried
Tailslide unmodified.
